title: Ami the Oven-man

paragraphs: Mentioned in Moed Katan 11a: Rav Yehudah permitted Ami the Oven-man to build ovens during the intermediate festival days. Rashi on the Rif explains that he was an oven-keeper. It is not known whether he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source prints עם where the syntax means “whether.” Its Hebrew is retained; scholarly status remains explicitly unknown.

The consulted Moed Katan passage records Rav Yehudah’s permission for Ami the oven-maker in its seasonal context. The Rashi-on-the-Rif report was not independently collated; an unavailable catalogue result does not show that the work or reading is absent. Hyman’s uncertainty about whether Ami was a Torah scholar remains unresolved.
